CREATE TABLE public.customers (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, email TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT, country TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE public.orders (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES public.customers(id), status TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT orders_status_check CHECK (status IN ('paid', 'pending', 'refunded', 'cancelled')), total_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL)
